title: Uncertainty-normalised (conformal-style) selection for the crypto ENTRY model at matched coverage vs plain predicted-R threshold (conformal_calibration family)

frontier.baseline: RAW LightGBM at the served tau, same 13 monthly origins, same rows, graded on actual net R at the canonical cost stack
frontier.consumer: src/units/strategies/ml_entry.py (D3) on bybit_2 real money + mirror + prop
frontier.design_sketch: arm in ml_entry_residual.py: per refit split train by time into proper (first 80%) and calibration (last 20%); mu = LightGBM on proper; sigma = LightGBM on |y - mu| over calibration (or normalised split-conformal); score = mu / sigma; threshold s* chosen ON THE CALIBRATION SLICE so E.policy(score, s*) takes as many decisions there as E.policy(mu, tau) does (matched coverage, point-in-time, never on the test window); graded paired vs RAW by decide_vs_raw. Open design question before authoring: matched count on calibration vs matched count per test window (the latter peeks).
frontier.next_step: unit RQ-20261112-4654-08 (RULE-RQ20261112-4654-08-CONF-MATCHED) + conf arm in PR #25571 (stacked on #25559); design question resolved: coverage matched on CAL-B inside the training rows (point-in-time), never per test window. Grade when it lands.
frontier.source: ML-F3 design (RQ-20261011-9da8-03, retired 2026-11-06 with no verdict; scorer scripts/research/conformal_abstain_eval.py on main) and RQ-20261016-65ff-25 (conformal vs plain threshold at matched coverage on published regime shards: FAIL, a science result)
